Our Story

About 2MG Sports Park

Kigali's leading destination for authentic sports gear — serving athletes, teams and fans since day one.

Who We Are

Passion for Sport

2MG Sports Park was born from a simple belief: every athlete in Rwanda deserves access to premium, 100% authentic sports gear — without compromise. We are Kigali's #1 sports destination, stocking the freshest drops from Nike, Adidas, Puma, New Balance and more.

From football boots to gym equipment, from running shoes to official team jerseys, we bring you the real deal — sourced directly from official brand distributors and delivered to your door or ready for in-store pickup at either of our two branches across Kigali.

Whether you're a professional athlete, a weekend warrior, or buying a gift for someone who lives for sport — 2MG Sports Park has you covered.

Our Values

What We Stand For

✅
100% Authenticity
Every product in our stores is genuine, sourced directly from official brand distributors. No fakes, no compromises.
🏆
Quality First
We curate only the best — from top-tier football boots to premium training kits, quality runs through everything we do.
🤝
Community
We are part of the Kigali sports community. We support local teams, athletes, and the next generation of champions.
🚀
Always Fresh
We stay on top of every release, every drop, every new colourway — so you always get the latest before anyone else.
